auth.login.tagline: Access your sovereign, federated space on AT Protocol.
auth.login.pdsAuto: Kelo Social automatically detects the PDS associated with your account.

auth.signup.title: Create a Kelo Social account
auth.signup.tagline: Join the sovereign and decentralized social network.
auth.signup.captchaInfo: When you click Sign up, the secure Kelo Social PDS captcha will open. Once validated, account creation will resume automatically.
auth.signup.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the verification window. Allow pop-ups for Kelo Social and try again.
landing.hero.title: The social network that lets you
landing.hero.description: A modern social experience built on AT Protocol, with verifiable identity, algorithm choices and an architecture open to multiple PDS providers.
landing.preview.post: A social network that gives you choices: your identity, your algorithm, your experience. ✨
landing.highlights.algorithms: You choose the level you want
landing.why.title: A different way to think about social networking.
landing.why.description: Kelo Social is not simply trying to recreate a familiar interface. The project starts from problems users face and aims to give them more choice.
landing.cards.algorithm.title: Your algorithm
landing.cards.algorithm.text: Adjust the intensity of your algorithm in settings instead of being forced into a single choice.
landing.cards.identity.title: A verifiable identity
landing.cards.identity.text: Kelo ID helps distinguish people and different types of organizations with appropriate statuses.
landing.cards.federation.title: Open to federation
landing.cards.federation.text: Kelo Social is part of the AT Protocol ecosystem and can work with multiple compatible PDS providers.
landing.cards.modern.title: A modern experience
landing.cards.modern.text: An interface designed to stay clear, pleasant and consistent on desktop, tablet and mobile.
landing.keloid.title: Fewer fake accounts. More context.
landing.keloid.text: Verification is handled separately by Kelo ID so Kelo Social can recognize a status without turning your identity documents into public social-network data.
landing.cta.title: Your next feed can start here.
landing.cta.text: Create your account or connect a compatible AT Protocol account and discover Kelo Social.
landing.footer.tagline: A social experience built around AT Protocol.
